title: Hire Desk Coordinator
description:
Join a busy customer operations team where no two days are the same

KMC Recruitment is working with a well-established hire business to recruit a Hire Desk Coordinator for its Ipswich operation.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking with customers, coordinating multiple tasks at once and making sure everything runs smoothly from enquiry through to delivery. You'll be part of a supportive team, acting as the first point of contact for customers while working closely with colleagues across the business to deliver a first-class service.

Whether you're already working within the hire industry or have a strong customer service background and are looking for your next challenge, we'd like to hear from you.

The Role

As part of a busy customer service and hire desk team, you'll be responsible for managing customer enquiries, arranging hires and ensuring customers receive a professional, efficient service throughout the process.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Responding to customer enquiries by telephone and email.
- Preparing quotations and processing hire orders accurately.
- Liaising with operational teams to coordinate deliveries, collections and equipment availability.
- Building strong relationships with both new and existing customers.
- Providing advice on products and services to help customers find the right solution.
- Supporting Business Development Managers with customer accounts and enquiries.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all documentation is completed correctly.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver excellent service and resolve any issues quickly.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering outstanding customer service.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, hire desk, sales support or coordination role.
- Excellent communication skills, both over the phone and in writing.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, including Excel.
- A positive attitude and willingness to support the wider team.
- GCSE English (Grade 4/C or above), or equivalent.

Experience within the plant hire, construction, tool hire or related sectors would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,640.
- Up to 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Option to buy additional holiday and carry unused leave forward.
- Extra day's holiday for your birthday.
- Company pension with employer contribution.
- Enhanced family leave.
- Death in Service cover.
- Medicash healthcare plan.
- High street retail discounts.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- Regular performance and development reviews.
- A friendly, supportive working environment with genuine opportunities to develop your career.

If you're looking for a customer-focused role where you can make a real impact while developing your career within a successful national business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Pricing Coordinator
description:
Help turn pricing strategy into accurate, controlled action. As Pricing Operations Coordinator, you'll play a key role in ensuring approved pricing decisions are implemented efficiently, consistently and correctly across our systems. You'll work closely with Pricing Strategy and Optimisation analysts and commercial stakeholders, helping protect data integrity while improving the way pricing activity is delivered.

Your mission

Your mission is to ensure approved pricing changes are executed accurately, on time and in line with agreed controls. You'll own the implementation of pricing requests, enabling our analysts to focus on strategy while you help maintain strong and reliable data.

What you'll be doing
- Execute approved pricing changes across relevant systems
- Complete bulk uploads and other recurring pricing activities using standard procedures and approved templates
- Validate pricing requests before execution, ensuring instructions are complete, accurate and compliant
- Maintain a clear and auditable record of requests, approvals, execution and validation
- Carry out post-implementation quality checks to confirm changes have been applied correctly
- Monitor work queues and prioritise requests
- Identify failed uploads, anomalies, SLA breaches and recurring issues through exception reporting
- Support new pricing capabilities, system changes, automation and process improvements
- Work with Pricing Strategy and Optimisation analysts to simplify, standardise, batch or automate recurring activities

Who we're looking for

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy structured, detail-focused work, take pride in getting things right first time and are comfortable managing high-volume activity without compromising quality.

We're looking for someone who brings:
- Strong attention to detail and a clear commitment to accuracy, quality and data integrity
- Confidence working with repetitive or high-volume tasks while maintaining consistent standards
- Experience following structured processes, standard operating procedures, approval controls and service level expectations
- Strong Excel skills, including working with structured data, templates and bulk-upload files
- The ability to identify exceptions, investigate issues and escalate clearly without making unsupported assumptions
- Good organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing requests
- Clear written and verbal communication skills
- A proactive, collaborative approach and a continuous-improvement mindset

How you'll make an impact
- Deliver pricing requests accurately and within agreed turnaround times
- Maintain strong first-time-right performance and quality assurance standards
- Keep work-in-progress and backlogs within agreed thresholds
- Identify and resolve pricing exceptions quickly and effectively
- Produce clear management information on throughput, accuracy, productivity and SLA performance
- Improve operational controls, consistency and scalability
- Help reduce manual effort by identifying opportunities for standardisation and automation
- Build trusted working relationships across Pricing Strategy and Optimisation, Commercial, Technology and Data teams

title: Clinical Team Administrator
description: The 12-bedded Dragonfly Unit is based in Carlton Colville, Lowestoft and is for age 13-17 year old young people requiring admission whilst receiving inpatient mental health treatment. We are currently seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Clinical Team Support Administrator for the Dragonfly Unit based at Carlton Court Hospital in Lowestoft. This team is part of our Suffolk Children's, Family and Young People's services in the Norfolk and Suffolk Foundation Trust. This post is a substantive full time post . The post holder will have varied Admin duties including minute-taking, reception cover, arranging meetings, diary management, typing of letters, updating service users records and providing general support to the MDT and clinical team. The Post Holder will provide administration support to our very busy unit and would be expected to work alongside the wider admin team based within this area. Good office-based skills would be required; however, full training will be provided. Experience of minuting meetings is essential in this role. Do you have excellent communications skills and a keen eye for detail? Can you effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities? Do you have experience of managing detailed complex information and maintaining astrong degree of confidentiality? If you have said 'Yes' to each of the above, then we might just have the role for you. You will need to demonstrate exceptional interpersonal skills with a dedication to confidentiality and service user experience and will also have excellent customer service skills and administration experience. You will be joining a dedicated friendly team in a fast-paced environment using a range of clinical systems and Microsoft packages. A working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages, including Word, Excel and Outlook will be essential. Knowledge of the Trust system Lorenzo would be an advantage, as well as Minute Taking. Reception cover is expected within this post and this role is office based. All equipment necessary will be provided and full training given. The Post Holder will provide a friendly and welcoming Reception Area for our Service Users and Clinical Staff who use the building. There will be varied administration duties, including support of Doctors, Nurses and Clinicians with attendance at meeting for minuting purposes. Communication with service users and their parents/carers is required. Providing diary/appointment management, attending team meetings, minute taking, where appropriate. To provide the best service to our Service Users the ideal candidate will be able to work on their own initiative, to remain calm under pressure, and maintain a positive attitude. Please find attached our Job Description and Person Specification for more detail on your Key Accountabilities, then if you feel you have what it takes to make a difference in your local communities, click APPLY

title: Medical Receptionist
description: A rare opportunity has arisen in our Reception/Admin team to help with this busy service. We are looking for someone who can work 16-20 hours a week flexibly as needed over Monday Friday between 7.30am and 8.00pm (to 8.00pm would be only on one day a week, currently a Tuesday) when required. If you enjoy working with the public, colleagues and computer systems, then please consider applying! The job can be stressful and very busy at times, so personal resilience is required. In return you will be part of the Victoria Road Surgery Team which has a great reputation locally; is sociable and friendly with lots of charitable and fun events going on throughout the year. For further information or to arrange an informal visit before applying, please contact Assistant Practice Manager Mrs Angela Blowers at angela.blowers@nhs.net or phone 01502 572369 and ask to speak to Angela or practice manager Mrs Michelle Kears. We look forward to hearing from you. Provide a friendly welcome to patients Manage the phone system, taking calls and messages and referring patients to various services using care navigation techniques Manage the online messaging service between patients and the surgery, reading and then dealing with these patient requests and queries appropriately Explain practice appointments policies (including home visit requests) and book patients appointments with appropriate clinicians using TPP SystmOne clinical software Handing completed repeat prescriptions and other correspondence to patients having checked name, address and date of birth Be able to cover all reception positions as necessary Complete Reception tasks on SystmOne such as arranging GP requested follow-up appointments for patients JOB DESCRIPTION REPORTS TO: RECEPTION MANAGER HOURS: 16-20 hours per week Job Summary: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, in person, over the telephone and in written correspondence e.g. online messages, to patients. Job Responsibilities: To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures To work in accordance with written protocols To read all correspondence sent to the Reception team or individually by task or email and respond as necessary To keep up to date with all mandatory training (most of this is online) Other tasks if needed (such as prescription and registration work), only with agreement and after the appropriate training is given Clear rooms after surgeries Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm Make hot or cold drinks for doctors, nurse practitioners and colleagues Any other tasks allocated by managers Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, Practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the Practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the Practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. If unsure of anything in this regard the postholder must first seek advice from the Reception Manager, the Deputy Reception Manager, the Assistant Practice Manager or the Practice Manager. Do not feel pressured to give information to someone just because they demand it. Sharing confidential information when not appropriate could constitute gross misconduct and may result in disciplinary action being taken against the postholder. Health & Safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the Practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to Practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Reporting potential risks identified Equality and Diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with Practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional Development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the Practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the Practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the Implementation of Services: The post-holder will: Apply Practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate
